resources.string: Show notification when location will set

Enable this module in LSPosed Manager.

Don’t have LSPosed?
	1. Install the Riru or Zygisk module from Magisk Manager
	2. Install the “Riru or Zygisk - LSPosed” module from Magisk Manager
	3. Open this app again
A module which will set your location where you want without enable mock location.
Metres the reported position may wander from the anchor. 0 pins it exactly.

Emit the offset coordinate system used in mainland China. No effect outside it.
Also report the time zone of the spoofed place. Affects every date the app formats.
Capturing cell towers, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth. This takes a few seconds.
Captured %1$d cell towers, %2$d access points and %3$d beacons.
Off is usually right: the tile host is normally reachable directly, and measurably faster that way.
Place search and address lookup go to nominatim.openstreetmap.org, which many networks block.
Download zoom %1$d to %2$d for the visible area?\n\nVector tiles, so the whole range comes in one pass.
Draw from downloaded regions and never fetch tiles
Wanders up to %1$d m from the anchor
No saved places yet.\nTap the star on the map to add one.
No position was captured, so the radio data will be replayed at the point already set on the map.

Replaces the radio data with %1$d cells, %2$d access points and %3$d beacons that belong to no real network — operator %4$s, SSIDs starting %5$s.\n\nFor checking the hooks fire: a recording from this phone contains its own real towers, so it cannot tell a hooked read from an unhooked one. The position stays where it is.
This reading may not be real

The position just read back matches the point being simulated. This app is normally excluded from its own hooks, so that usually means it has been added to its own scope in the Xposed manager. Remove it there, or treat this reading as the simulated value rather than your actual location.
Position and the recorded surroundings (%1$d cells, %2$d Wi-Fi, %3$d beacons)
Position only — the carrier stays real, tower and access-point identifiers are fabricated so a lookup finds nothing and the app falls back to GNSS
Also record the cells, Wi-Fi and beacons here
Recorded where you are now, saved against the coordinate above.
Device position unknown — tap the locate button to compare
Could not reach the search service
The request to nominatim.openstreetmap.org did not get through, so this is not a spelling problem.\n\nProxy for place search is %3$s (%1$s:%2$s). Map tiles have their own switch and are unaffected.
